claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-590885 is a potent and selective BRAF inhibitor that, at 2.5 uM, most plausibly kills BRAF-mutant melanoma and colorectal cancer lines through on-target inhibition of mutant BRAF and downstream MAPK signaling, with possible weak off-target kinase inhibition at this concentration.
